map.最关键的是「同一密钥流绝对不能重用」：流密码把明文与密钥流逐位异或，若两组明文用: The most critical rule is "never reuse the same keystream": a stream cipher XORs the plaintext bit-by-bit with the keystream. If two plaintexts use the same keystream (same key + IV/nonce), XORing them cancels the key and yields the XOR of the two plaintexts. Therefore every encryption must use a unique nonce; also, stream ciphers provide no integrity protection, so pair them with a MAC or use an AEAD.
map.密钥装入：取密钥字节每 4 个拼成一个 32 位字写入状态 X（不足的字节补 0: Key loading: the key bytes are packed 4 at a time into 32-bit words written into state X (missing bytes padded with 0), 8 words in total; the i-th word of counter C is the i-th word of X rotated left by 16 bits. It first idles for 4 rounds; if an initial vector of at least 8 bytes is provided, its first 4 bytes and last 4 bytes are packed into iv0 and iv1, words 0, 2, 4, 6 of C are XORed with iv0, words 1, 3, 5, 7 with iv1, and it idles 4 more rounds. Each round advances: the state words are added in index order with the corresponding constant-table word and the previous carry, the carry is the sum shifted right by 32 bits, and finally the carry is added back to word 0 of C; then the g function is computed — split the word into high 16 bits and low 16 bits and take "high×high XOR low16 XOR cross-product shifted left 16 XOR low×low shifted right 16"; X is then rolled forward from the g values of X plus C: odd items add the next item rotated left 16 bits combined with the previous item rotated left 8 bits. The keystream is generated every 16 bytes: 16 words are obtained by XORing state words crosswise with left/right shifts, and plaintext/ciphertext is XORed byte by byte with the lowest 8 bits of those words
